name: The Gray Wolf and the Little Lamb
source:
. . . Once upon a time
There lived The Gray Wolf and The Little Lamb
One was infamously cruel while the other had a heart of gold
They both egotistically believed they could teach one another a life lesson
But maybe they can become friends in the end?

[From [url=https://amordochka.itch.io/tgwtll]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
。。。曾几何时
那里住着灰太狼和小羊羔
一个人残忍无情，另一个人却有一颗金子般的心
他们都自负地相信他们可以给彼此上一堂人生课
但也许他们最终能成为朋友？
